summary: Sandbach United suffered a disappointing 3-2 defeat to Foley Meir in their opening fixture, squandering several chances and conceding soft goals that proved costly in the end. Saul Shotton grabbed a late consolation with a fine volley, but it wasn't enough to salvage the result. The team will look to bounce back this Saturday at home against Stafford Town, a promotion contender, and will need to tighten up defensively and convert their opportunities if they're to get back to winning ways.
